scope: Close the A04 numerical and contract-freeze decision in one requested execution batch. Assess native ARM and isolated OCI separately. A06 adapter, A07 independent physical validation, A11 dynamics and public rollout are downstream acceptance, outside A04.

baseline.basis_history: The original G2 TZ/QZ pilot did not meet criteria. Reuse verified G0/G1 and unchanged baselines. This is the alternative QZ/5Z path through gates equivalent to G2–G6, with retained historical outcomes.

fixed.method: PBE/GAPW all-electron, nonrelativistic, isolated neutral singlet, fixed authored nuclear geometry and MT solver.
fixed.unchanged_controls: Locked A04 units, precision, state, potential ALL, LMAXN0 2, raw total signed density STRIDE 1, explicit OT/SCF and output diagnostics. Document candidate settings as internal evidence and keep fixture identifiers out of the user schema.

tuples.cell_rule: Use the exact authored decimal as a rational for translation, shell boundaries, and centered crop. Before execution validate single-factor deck diffs, supported FFT sizes, and arithmetic. Candidate cell is always 12 Å. Confirm actual headers; predicted axis sizes are H2 cell axis 180/216/240, He cell axis 240/270/288 and He joint 288. If any essential comparison cannot be aligned, close with missing admissible evidence. The smaller He reference domain is explicit; it does not carry a 16 or 20 Å claim.

per_fixture_unique_decks: QZ candidate with only the reference REL_CUTOFF
QZ candidate with only the reference CUTOFF
QZ candidate with only middle finite cell
QZ candidate with only largest finite cell
pilot_only_decks: QZ joint-reference tuples at LMAXN1 6 for H2-short and He, paired with their LMAXN1 6 candidate rows in B0
He at 12 Å and common existing QZ controls including LMAXN1 6, four CUTOFF decks 1000/1100/1200/1400. The 1000 Ry deck can reuse the exact He B0 candidate row.

AV03.rule: Refine each SCF/grid/atomic-grid family separately; compare two finest levels with other families fixed sufficiently fine.
AV03.origin: Quanta predeclared engineering acceptance, not source-certified uncertainty

AV04.rule: Two finest compatible basis levels, same method/grid and geometry; no complete-basis accuracy claim.
AV04.origin: Quanta predeclared engineering acceptance, not source-certified uncertainty

AV05.rule: Engine all-electron hard+soft integral compared to 2.
AV05.origin: Quanta predeclared engineering acceptance, not source-certified uncertainty

AV06.rule: Explicit full hard+soft electron-number density export: integral rho*dV compared to 2, including field/grid refinement.
AV06.origin: Quanta predeclared engineering acceptance, not source-certified uncertainty
AV06.blocked_until: A02/A04 full-density export semantics pinned; soft or signed total charge density cannot substitute

thresholds.same_native_lattice: Require actual geometry, shape, origin, and axes match. Compare signed samples directly.
thresholds.different_lattices: Validate centered crop and reference extent. Require both 4- and 6-point signed L1 within the existing limit when interpolation is needed. Keep Fourier diagnostics separate from that rule.
thresholds.He_reference_readiness_only: Predeclare the same 0.001-electron limit for the distinct-grid 1200→1400 Fourier L1 in B0 as a conservative admission criterion for the finer-reference pair. Keep shared nodes, sampled-reference and round-trip values as diagnostics. This does not change earlier acceptance or imply continuum bounds.

batch.action: Recheck current heads, baseline evidence and live pinned x86/ARM artifact bytes, sources, binaries and BSE coefficients. Verify the older successful ARM regression applicability and the later recorded failure separately. Implement the bounded input matrix, rational-cell comparison and locked 5Z support, validate per-row hashes, one-factor deck differences, previous deck-byte identity, negative cases and isolated controls. Commit exact deck/resource manifest and dependencies before first scientific calculation. Prepare conditional new OCI allowlist/control in parallel if operation is authorized. Rebuild missing assets inside the batch only with pinned source, A03/GAPW and same-deck equivalence evidence.

In B0 run He 1200→1400 at 12 Å using prior controls. Require real grid refinement, AV03/05/06, both interpolation estimates and the separately specified Fourier admission criterion. Compare He 1000→1100 directly on native signed samples if actual lattices match, with AV03/05/06 and L1; a missing plateau blocks that diagnostic gate. Run both pilot candidate-to-joint comparisons at LMAXN1 6, enforce cell shell and omitted-domain criteria. Before B1 preserve exact settings, alignment and method-specific results. Native shared points and fine-only round trips explain comparison sensitivity, without treating norms as additive.

For short H2 and He compare QZ LMAXN1 6→8 with only the setting changed. Verify the consumed angular setting, actual effective maximum, expected 30 QZ/55 5Z spherical functions per atom, SCF and overlap. Compare candidate QZ–5Z on identical native lattices with both at LMAXN1 8; the only changes are the locked basis file and KIND labels. Require AV03 for bridge, AV04 for basis, AV05/06 and field L1 for both. The 5Z result never serves as its own basis reference.

Run the same bridge and basis gates on the other three H2 structures, then run all five independent QZ axes: both stricter SCF levels, radial, Lebedev, CUTOFF, REL_CUTOFF and finite cell. Compare candidate to finest and the two finest when three levels exist. Require boundary and omitted-domain checks for admissible cell pairs. Directly compare candidate QZ to jointly finer QZ, and QZ–5Z at both common tuples. Reuse exact successful decks where possible; preserve raw signed CUBE evidence until all dependent comparisons finish. A single required row failure blocks freeze.

Replay the five selected byte-identical decks on pinned native ARM. Check input and provenance, ordered E/F, electron counts, exact lattice and native signed L1. Report raw CUBE digest separately from numeric equivalence. For an intended OCI profile, qualify those same admitted decks via a new fixed, authorized operation/request UUID with matching successful control CI, idle preflight, actual memory reserve, web and DB/WAL protection, one-at-a-time monitoring and cleanup. OCI suitability is independent of the development freeze; old fixed DZ OCI evidence is historical.

Always aggregate reports and independent branch status, including failed or skipped gates. Record one terminal A04 decision for this batch. Freeze only an evidenced numeric profile with explicit units, origin/transform, boundary, contract negative cases, source/asset hashes and tested five geometries. Do not extend evidence to continuous geometry or production. Write immutable compact receipt plus WORKPLAN, profile, roadmap and same-ID Drive model section. Advance to A05/A06 after development freeze. Preserve the named no-go or incomplete cause if a required row failed or was not admitted, and close this batch without inventing new experiments.

limits.isolation: One rank/thread/deck at a time per runner. Parallelize independent fixtures and shards, not calculations on the same host. Split long reference jobs into shards within the time budget.
limits.resource_protection: No swap for this matrix. Preserve 2 GiB host RAM; disk admission 10 GiB and stop guard 6 GiB; preserve 1 GiB/file and 2 GiB/work dir limits and account separately for retained references. Cap zero production load. On resource failure record resource no-go; no paid capacity, adaptive physics retries, or arbitrary OCI shell.
limits.retry: At most one exact-input retry in the batch for a documented transient infrastructure failure, with original guards and within the deadline. No retry for scientific failure.
limits.OCI: Optional only for intended operating scope and authorized fixed route. Recheck actual idle headroom from host, reserve 2 GiB, no swap. If no admitted envelope, classify OCI qualification as incomplete inside this batch. Heavy references stay isolated development work.

terminal_decision.frozen_for_exact_scope: Every required F0–F4 development row passed. Freeze development candidate for explicitly evidenced scope; record OCI independently.
terminal_decision.closed_no_go: A required scientific or contract criterion failed. Record failure, skipped dependent rows and no A04 freeze.
terminal_decision.closed_incomplete: A required prerequisite, host envelope, time, or evidence was unavailable. Record reason and no A04 freeze.
terminal_decision.no_open_ended_followup: This is the final batch for the specified A04 candidate scope. The task can finish without a further validation round by issuing one of the terminal decisions. A pass cannot be promised before measurement. No automatic new basis, tolerance, profile, or validation round.
